transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I... well, I suppose I'm here because my eating has been... off. For months now. Some days I just pick at toast or have a coffee, and then... other times I find myself just buying sweets I don't even really want. It's just... all turned around.
Do you ever find yourself eating a lot in a short period of time, like a binge, and then do anything to try to 'undo' that, like making yourself sick, fasting, or exercising a lot?
No, I... I don't do that. I just... eat poorly, I suppose. I don't try to undo it.
When you're eating, do you ever feel like you can't control how much you eat or feel compelled to keep eating even when you don't want to?
No... I don't think so. I just... eat whatever it is and that's it. I've never felt like I couldn't stop.
Have you experienced a loss of appetite or significant weight loss over the past few months?

Well... like I mentioned when I first came in, it's just been all turned around for months now. Some days the appetite isn't really there, which is why I just pick at the toast and coffee. But then I'll find myself standing in the bakery aisle getting those sweets I don't even really enjoy. I haven't really been keeping track of my weight, honestly... it's just my eating that's off.
Have you noticed a significant loss of appetite or weight loss over the past few months?
I... I think I just said. I haven't really noticed losing weight or anything. I don't step on a scale. It's just... like I told you a moment ago.
Do you ever feel like you're not in control of your eating or find yourself eating even when you don't really want to?
I... I think we just went over this. No. I don't feel out of control. I just eat what I eat.
Can you think of a time when you started eating and felt like you couldn't stop, even if you wanted to?
No. I don't think so. I just... I don't eat like that.
Do you ever find yourself eating even when you're not really hungry or continue eating even after you feel full?
No. I really don't. I just... eat when it's time, and then I stop. That's all.
Do you ever find yourself eating even when you're not really hungry or continue eating even after you feel full?
I... you just asked me that exact same thing. No. Like I said, I don't do that.
Do your eating habits cause you a lot of distress or interfere with your daily life, like work, relationships, or social activities?
No. Like I just said, my eating is fine. It doesn't... cause any problems for me.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy over the past few months?

I suppose. Um... most days I just wake up with this... heavy, sad feeling sitting on me. I don't really know how to explain it. Even if I'm just sitting in my bright kitchen with the coffee going... it just feels like the warmth has gone out of everything.
Have you felt this way most days, and has it been affecting how you go about your day, like getting things done or enjoying time with others?

Most days, yes. I... I still manage the basics for my aunt. I have to. 

But... I guess I've missed some church planning calls lately. And I keep putting off my fair projects. The neighbors have had to step in and cover a few things I used to just handle easily on my own. It's just... everything feels harder right now. Caregiving, staying involved in town... it's just harder.
Has this heavy, sad feeling been present nearly every day, and does it last throughout most of the day?
I guess so. Yes. It's... it's just there. Most of the time.
